title: Feynman Technique Concept
prompt: Explain [INSERT CONCEPT] using the Feynman technique. Break it down into simple terms as if you were teaching it to a 12-year-old. Use an analogy to make it easy to grasp.

title: Weekly Meal Planner
prompt: Create a 7-day high-protein dinner meal plan. Include a strict grocery shopping list categorized by supermarket aisles, and keep all recipes under 30 minutes of prep time.

title: Marketing Hook Generator
prompt: Generate 5 compelling, scroll-stopping hooks for a short-form video (TikTok/Reels) promoting [INSERT PRODUCT/SERVICE]. Use psychological triggers like curiosity, fear of missing out, or common pain points.

title: Regex Generator
prompt: Write a regular expression in JavaScript that matches [INSERT REQUIREMENTS]. Explain how each part of the regex works step-by-step, and provide 3 testing examples (2 valid, 1 invalid).
